title: Shared Group-Rational KAN parents for adapter-bank compression
hypothesis: A shared group-rational parent basis with compact task/domain Views retains heldout adapter outputs while reducing complete bytes versus independent KanAdapter modules and improves on native shared-parent coefficient controls.

world.adapter: parallel residual scalar functions composed over shared rational basis features
world.teacher: task adapter coefficients generated from fixed shared rational parents

fresh.release_rule: Keep fresh sealed after native coefficient alias or failure of complete-byte/quality gate.

controls: native shared rational basis with task coefficients
frozen shared parent without task code
success_gate: heldout nRMSE <=0.02, at least 25% fewer complete bytes than independent KanAdapter bank, strict gain over native shared-parent coefficients, and no old-task retention loss.
failure_gate: FAIL if native shared-parent coefficients match Mirror or full storage gate misses.
boundaries: Synthetic analytic adapter functions only; no pretrained speech or KanAdapter model reproduction.
Heldout task coefficients remain in inference payload; no task-code inference is tested.
No fresh runs after exact native alias or gate failure.
